exposure: MEOWS chart triggers (single markedly abnormal observation 'red trigger', two simultaneously mildly abnormal observations 'two yellow triggers')
cohort: The study included 1065 pregnant women in labour (>28 weeks of gestation) and postpartum women up to 6 weeks after delivery.
finding: The MEOWS chart was found to be 86.4% sensitive and 85.2% specific for predicting obstetric morbidity, with individual physiological parameters also significantly correlated with morbidity.
